subject.title: [Feature]: Channel plugin threading policy for automatic subagent parameter injection

question: Should OpenClaw add channel-declared auto-injection for `sessions_spawn` thread/session parameters, and if yes what public SDK shape should own it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing implicit defaults changes public plugin SDK behavior and can alter routing, persistence, and message delivery for existing users.

options.title: Design Unified Policy First
options.body: Settle the thread-binding and persistent-session contract across current-placement and child-placement channels before adding auto-injection fields or defaults.

options.title: Keep Explicit Parameters
options.body: Leave `thread` and `mode` explicit until a stronger product need justifies implicit routing changes.

options.title: Ship Narrow Auto-Injection
options.body: Add a small channel metadata policy now and accept that broader persistent-session work may revise the API later.

recommendation.title: Design Unified Policy First
recommendation.body: Settle the thread-binding and persistent-session contract across current-placement and child-placement channels before adding auto-injection fields or defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent core thread-binding refactor makes this the best available owner for the product/API direction.
